# Nord MCP server (AI game making)

<!-- GENERATED by `node mcp/nord-mcp.mjs --docs`. Edit mcp/GUIDE.md, mcp/lib/*.mjs or this generator, never this file. -->

An MCP server (stdio, Node 18+, no dependencies) that lets an AI agent (Claude Code, opencode, Codex, pi, any MCP client) build a complete Nord game: create projects, edit scenes and scripts, validate, build, and model/texture 3D props with a software preview so the AI can *see* its work. It starts with built-in guidance (`nord_guide`, resources `nord://guide/<topic>`, prompts `make-a-game` and `model-a-prop`) that reads the engine's own docs, so the guidance is always as current as the docs.

## Install
The server lives in the engine repo (`mcp/nord-mcp.mjs`). Build the CLI once (`cargo build -p nord-cli`; needed for `project_new`, `check_project`, `build_project`, `serve_start`). Replace paths with yours; `node mcp/nord-mcp.mjs --config <client>` prints these for your checkout.

### claude
```
# Claude Code (project scope; add --scope user for all projects)
claude mcp add nord -- node <engine>/mcp/nord-mcp.mjs --project /path/to/your/project

# or .mcp.json in the project:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nord": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "<engine>/mcp/nord-mcp.mjs",
        "--project",
        "/path/to/your/project"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### opencode
```
# opencode.json (project) or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "nord": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": [
        "node",
        "<engine>/mcp/nord-mcp.mjs",
        "--project",
        "/path/to/your/project"
      ],
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

### codex
```
# ~/.codex/config.toml   (or: codex mcp add nord -- node <engine>/mcp/nord-mcp.mjs --project /path/to/your/project)
[mcp_servers.nord]
command = "node"
args = ["<engine>/mcp/nord-mcp.mjs", "--project", "/path/to/your/project"]
```

### pi
```
# pi has no built-in MCP client; use the pi-mcp-adapter extension, then ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json (or .pi/mcp.json in the project):
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nord": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "<engine>/mcp/nord-mcp.mjs",
        "--project",
        "/path/to/your/project"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Two entries are possible: `nord` (everything) and `nord-modeler` (`--only modeler`: just the 3D tools). Set `NORD_PROJECT` or `--project` so tools know the project; `project_open` switches at runtime. `NORD_BIN` points at a specific `nord` binary.

## Safety
File tools are jailed to the project folder (no `..`, symlinks resolved, `.git`/`target`/`node_modules` protected, 8 MB limit, JSON validated). There is no delete tool and no shell tool. `serve_start` runs only `nord serve` on the project.

## Tools (37)
### Project, scenes and guidance
### `nord_guide`
READ THIS FIRST. Guidance for making games with Nord Engine. No topic: the workflow guide and the topic list. With a topic: the matching engine documentation (always the current text from the engine's docs/). Also accepts "docs/<file>.md" or "tut-t05-physics" style names.

Parameters: `topic` (string), `offset` (integer)

### `project_open`
Point the tools at a Nord project folder (it must contain nord.project.json). Returns project_info.

Parameters: `path`* (string)

### `project_new`
Create a new project with the nord CLI from a template (html, 2d, 3d, or a starter id like platformer, endless-runner, fps-arena, card-game — see templates/) and open it.

Parameters: `dir`* (string), `template` (string)

### `project_templates`
List the starter templates available for project_new.

No parameters.

### `project_info`
Summary of the open project: manifest, scenes, scripts, prefabs, models, asset counts.

No parameters.

### `list_files`
List files in a project folder (recursive, max 300).

Parameters: `dir` (string), `pattern` (string)

### `read_file`
Read a text file of the project (max 200 KB; use offset for more).

Parameters: `path`* (string), `offset` (integer)

### `write_file`
Create/overwrite a project file (scripts, scenes, prefabs, json, css…). Parent folders are created. Use encoding "base64" for images/audio. Scripts: see nord_guide scripting. After writing scenes/prefabs run check_project.

Parameters: `path`* (string), `content`* (string), `encoding` (string)

### `component_schema`
Fields of the scene component types (sprite, model, camera, light, rigidbody, collider, audioSource, uiButton, spawner, netSync, …) taken from the editor's schema. Format: name:type=default. Without kind: all kinds.

Parameters: `kind` (string)

### `scene_create`
Create an empty scene file (format 1). Use scene_add_entity to fill it; set it as start scene with project_set_start_scene.

Parameters: `path`* (string)

### `project_set_start_scene`
Set the scene the game starts with.

Parameters: `scene`* (string)

### `scene_get`
Show a scene as a compact outline (entity id, name, components, scripts, children) or one entity as full JSON (id given). scene defaults to the start scene.

Parameters: `scene` (string), `id` (string)

### `scene_add_entity`
Add an entity to a scene. components: [{"type":"sprite","texture":"assets/x.png",…}] (see component_schema). scripts: [{"path":"scripts/player.js","attributes":{…}}]. transform: pos/rot/scale. parent: id of the parent entity. prefab: {"path":"prefabs/x.prefab.json"} to instance a prefab. 2D positions are pixels (y down); 3D positions are world units (y up). Returns the new id.

Parameters: `scene` (string), `name`* (string), `pos` (array), `rot` (array), `scale` (array), `components` (array), `scripts` (array), `tags` (array), `layer` (integer), `parent` (string), `prefab` (object)

### `scene_update_entity`
Change an entity: name, enabled, tags, layer, pos/rot/scale, set_components (add or replace by type), remove_components (types), scripts (replaces the list). Unmentioned fields stay.

Parameters: `scene` (string), `id`* (string), `name` (string), `enabled` (boolean), `tags` (array), `layer` (integer), `pos` (array), `rot` (array), `scale` (array), `set_components` (array), `remove_components` (array), `scripts` (array)

### `scene_remove_entity`
Remove an entity (and its children) from a scene.

Parameters: `scene` (string), `id`* (string)

### `check_project`
Validate the project and all scenes (ids, missing files, bad references) with `nord check`. Run after every batch of changes.

No parameters.

### `build_project`
Build a static offline web export with `nord build` (target auto | html | web-2d | web-3d …). Output folder default dist/. Options: single_file, minify, zip, pwa, host (itch|github-pages|netlify|vercel|docker).

Parameters: `target` (string), `out` (string), `single_file` (boolean), `minify` (boolean), `zip` (boolean), `pwa` (boolean), `host` (string)

### `serve_start`
Start the dev server (live reload, editor API) for the open project in the background. Open the URL in a browser to play. Returns the URL.

Parameters: `port` (integer)

### `serve_stop`
Stop the dev server started by serve_start.

No parameters.

### 3D Modeler
### `modeler_list`
List models in the project's models/ folder and the open modeler sessions.

No parameters.

### `modeler_new`
Start an empty model session. Build it with modeler_primitive / modeler_add_mesh, then modeler_save.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `color` (string)

### `modeler_open`
Open an existing model for editing: models/x.mesh.json (editable mesh) or any .glb/.gltf of the project (e.g. a model used in a scene). GLB import merges all meshes, bakes node transforms, keeps the first texture; skeleton/animation are dropped.

Parameters: `file`* (string), `name` (string)

### `modeler_describe`
Describe a model: counts, bounds, and a face table (index, direction, centre, vertex count) so you can address faces by index or direction. limit caps the face list.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `limit` (integer)

### `modeler_primitive`
Add a primitive (cube, plane, cylinder, sphere) with UVs. size = full extent per axis (a cube of size [1,1,1] spans -0.5..0.5). Returns the index range of the new faces.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `kind`* (string), `size` (array), `position` (array), `rotation` (array), `segments` (integer)

### `modeler_add_mesh`
Add raw geometry: vertices [[x,y,z]…] and faces as arrays of vertex indices (3+ per face, counter-clockwise seen from outside, planar). UVs are auto-unwrapped unless given.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `vertices`* (array), `faces`* (array), `uvs` (array)

### `modeler_transform`
Move / rotate / scale vertices of the selected faces (or all). Rotation/scale pivot is the centre of the selected vertices unless pivot is given.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `op`* (string), `value`* (array), `faces` (any), `vertices` (array), `pivot` (array)

### `modeler_extrude`
Extrude faces along their normals by distance (negative = inward), adding side walls. Each face is extruded on its own (use for windows, bumps, legs).

Parameters: `name`* (string), `faces`* (any), `distance`* (number), `inset` (number)

### `modeler_delete_faces`
Delete faces (unused vertices are removed). Indices of later faces shift: call modeler_describe again.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `faces`* (any)

### `modeler_mirror`
Duplicate the model mirrored across the origin plane (x, y or z) and weld the seam. Move the half away from the plane first or the copy overlaps.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `axis`* (string)

### `modeler_center_ground`
Centre the model on x/z and put its lowest point on y = 0.

Parameters: `name`* (string)

### `modeler_unwrap`
Recompute UVs: every face is projected along its dominant axis and all faces are packed into a grid on the texture. Run after changing geometry, before painting.

Parameters: `name`* (string)

### `modeler_set_color`
Colours: base colour of the whole model, or vertex colours of selected faces (multiplies with base colour and texture).

Parameters: `name`* (string), `color`* (string), `faces` (any)

### `modeler_texture_new`
Create (or reset) the texture: size×size pixels filled with a colour. Faces show the part of the image given by their UVs (see modeler_texture_uv for where each face is).

Parameters: `name`* (string), `size` (integer), `color` (string)

### `modeler_texture_uv`
Where faces sit on the texture, in the same normalised coordinates modeler_texture_paint uses (x right, y DOWN, 0..1). Use it to paint a specific face.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `faces` (any)

### `modeler_texture_paint`
Paint on the texture. ops are applied in order; coordinates are normalised 0..1 with y DOWN (top-left origin). shapes: fill{color} · rect{x0,y0,x1,y1,color} · circle{x,y,radius,color} · line{x0,y0,x1,y1,width,color} · polygon{points,color} · noise{x0,y0,x1,y1,color,amount,seed}. alpha (0..1) blends.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `ops`* (array)

### `modeler_preview`
Render the model with a built-in software renderer and return PNG image(s). ALWAYS look at the result after modelling or painting. views: iso, front, back, left, right, top, bottom (or give yaw/pitch degrees).

Parameters: `name`* (string), `views` (array), `yaw` (number), `pitch` (number), `size` (integer), `zoom` (number)

### `modeler_save`
Write models/<name>.mesh.json (editable) and, by default, models/<name>.glb (use it in a scene: model component path "models/<name>.glb"). Also writes <name>.png when there is an editable texture.

Parameters: `name`* (string), `as` (string), `glb` (boolean)

## Keeping it in sync
Add or change tools in `mcp/lib/`, update `mcp/GUIDE.md` when workflows change, run `node mcp/nord-mcp.mjs --docs`. `node --test mcp/` fails if this file is stale or a tool is undocumented.
